label.en: After the next upgrade: Maturity stage built

label.zh: 升级后：巨型艺术设施完工
label.en: After the next upgrade: Installation completed

label.zh: 修复废墟（建造“修复”型巨型结构）后
label.en: After the ruin is restored (the "restored" megastructure type is built over it)

bridges.evidence: common/megastructures/08_mega_art_installation.txt:503 on_build_complete fires mega.9121; the restored type is upgrade_from the ruined type

notes.zh: 审阅说明：巨型艺术设施每完成一个建造阶段，由 on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded 在建造国触发对应事件（并非选项链接）；各阶段按建造顺序排列。9002 的正文按帝国伦理（如亲异）有所不同（megastructure_events_1.txt:3718-3745）。
notes.en: Review note: each build stage of the Mega Art Installation fires its own event for the builder from on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded (not option links); stages are shown in construction order. The text of 9002 varies with ethics (e.g. xenophile; megastructure_events_1.txt:3718-3745).

notes.zh: 审阅说明：废墟是地图上预置的，不属于任何建造阶段；首次进入该星系时由 on_entering_system_first_time 触发。
notes.en: Review note: the ruin is a pre-placed map object, not a build stage; on_entering_system_first_time fires this event the first time a ship enters the system.

scope.zh: 巨型艺术设施各建造阶段事件、给其他帝国的通知、废墟与修复事件。
scope.en: Mega Art Installation: build-stage events, notices to other empires, the ruin and restoration events.
